title: Customer GPU Pledge Slice Rollup — July 2026 (working)
body:
Purpose:
This working doc is a per-contract rollup of GPU pledge slices — how many GPU slices each dedicated customer currently holds, where those slices are pinned (region + machine class), observed utilization, and short-term runway risk.

Summary snapshot (as of 2026-07-12):
- Total pledge slices accounted for in this rollup: 312 slices (1 slice ~= 1 rtx-8000-equivalent vGPU slot for accounting)
- Safety buffer target: 12% of effective slices (standard across Dedicated)
- Overflow/fallback pool remaining: 28 slices (global)

Notes on terminology:
- "pledge slice": unit used for customer entitlement tracking (can map to full-node or vGPU depending on contract).
- "rebalancing window": weekly window when we can move slices across AZs/regions for utilization smoothing.

Per-customer lines (compact table):
Customer | Pledge ID | Region | GPU type | Slices | Avg util (7d) | Peak util | Runway (months) | Overflow OK | Notes
NimbleAI | P-0098 | us-west-2 | H100-80GB | 48 | 62% | 89% | 5.0 | yes | Staging spike on 7/9 — asked SE to throttle batch jobs.
Finlytics | P-0112 | eu-west-1 | A100-40GB | 32 | 46% | 78% | 10.5 | no | Contract SLA tier 2, cannot migrate to fallback pool without approval.
AtlasHealth | P-0101 | us-east-1 | A100-80GB | 64 | 79% | 96% | 2.1 | no | At-risk: runway <3 months if growth continues; discuss burst purchase or raise priority.
ShopScale | P-0120 | ap-southeast-1 | H100-80GB | 24 | 34% | 58% | 18.0 | yes | Low utilization; candidate for temporary redistribution during eu-west-1 pressure.
GovSecure | P-0077 | us-gov-west | A100-40GB | 16 | 55% | 71% | 8.2 | no | Private deployment (VPC) — manual approval required for any slice movement.
EdgeML Labs | P-0135 | us-central-1 | T4 | 8 | 24% | 40% | 24.0 | yes | Experimental workloads, try packing with other low-priority customers.

How runway was estimated:
- Runway (months) = (remaining billed slices + overflow credits usable) / average monthly consumption rate.
- Monthly consumption estimated from 7-day rolling average scaled to monthly cadence and adjusted for known upcoming rollouts (tickets listed below).

Operational observations and red flags:
- AtlasHealth is the primary immediate risk: sustained 80%+ utilization on A100-80GB nodes. If growth continues we will start hitting scheduling queueing within 6–8 weeks. Action: high priority capacity conversation with Sales/CS by 7/15. (Jira: ENGINF-3302)
- us-west-2 H100 pool has two nodes scheduled for maintenance on 2026-07-20; NimbleAI's peak windows overlap. Need to reassign temporary slices or enable fallback routing.
- eu-west-1: shortage of spare A100-40GB hardware due to capacity buyback. Finlytics cannot be moved to overflow without contract amendment; explore short-term rental or dedicated burst for 90 days.

Suggested rebalancing plan (next 30 days):
1) Move 8 slices from ShopScale (ap-southeast-1) to eu-west-1 temporary pool for AtlasHealth burst (requires cross-team sign-off).
2) Approve 12 overflow credits to AtlasHealth for the remainder of Q3, billable as overage.
3) Schedule H100 maintenance after NimbleAI agrees to a degraded SLT window or enable fallback to us-west-1 fallback pool.

Decision log (working):
- 2026-07-05: Overflow pool assignment rules tightened (ops-owned approvals required for >10% of a pool). Owner: Priya Kapoor.
- 2026-07-09: NimbleAI informed of temporary throttle during scheduled maintenance (ticket ENGINF-3290).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm whether GovSecure contract allows reuse of slices across regions for emergency capacity. Owner: Samir Patel. Due: 2026-07-14.
- Confirm H100 node count arriving in us-west-2 on 2026-07-25 (HW-PO# 7642). Procurement: Alejandro Ruiz.
- Update the billing model for overflow credits to show pro-rated daily charges in the console (product-ops ticket).

Quick calculation snippets (for reviewer eyeballing):
- Current accounted slices: 48+32+64+24+16+8 = 192 (subset shown above). Global total in sheet header = 312.
- Safety buffer target at 12% for 312 = ~37 slices. Overflow pool = 28 (below safety buffer by ~9 slices).

Attachments & references:
- Slack thread: #eng-infra "eu-west-1 pressure" (link in linked_artifacts).
- Jira tickets: ENGINF-3245 (rental request), ENGINF-3290 (nimbleai maintenance), ENGINF-3302 (atlashealth runway).
- Confluence: infra/gpu-capacity-playbook (procedure for rebalancing).

Next sync: Capacity standup deep-dive on 2026-07-13 09:30 PST (invite to eng-infrastructure). Please come with: confirmed contract clauses (CS), estimated launch dates (SE/solutions), and any procurement lead times (procurement).

Notes to self (Maya):
- Keep this doc as the short-list for emergency moves. After 7/15 decisions, fold final plan into the canonical "capacity-runway-tracker" sheet and update customer-facing notes.
- Call out any customers with legal restrictions so we don't accidentally propose cross-region moves.

End of rollup.
